name: Text to Speech
description: Converts text to spoken audio artifacts through configured cloud providers. Provider selection is explicit or uses the configured default.
brief: Use the `text-to-speech` skill only after an administrator enables it and configures a provider. The `generate_speech` tool accepts an explicit provider or uses the configured default provider and saves an audio artifact.
author: Evonic

variables.name: default_provider
variables.label: Default Provider
variables.description: Provider ID used when generate_speech does not specify a provider. It must identify an enabled provider.

variables.name: allow_local_providers
variables.label: Allow Approved Local Providers
variables.description: When enabled, permits enabled providers declared as local (e.g. the mock provider).

variables.name: google_gemini_enabled
variables.label: Enabled
variables.description: Enable Google Gemini speech synthesis using the configured credential.

variables.name: openai_enabled
variables.label: Enabled
variables.description: Enable OpenAI speech synthesis using the configured credential.

variables.name: mock_enabled
variables.label: Enabled
variables.description: Development and test only. Enable the deterministic mock provider.

variables.name: google_gemini_api_key
variables.label: Google Gemini API Key
variables.description: Write-only Google Generative Language API credential.

variables.name: google_gemini_model
variables.label: Google Gemini TTS Model
variables.description: Approved Gemini TTS model.

variables.name: google_gemini_voice
variables.label: Google Gemini Default Voice
variables.description: Voice used when the agent does not pick one (e.g. Kore, Puck, Charon, Zephyr).

variables.name: google_gemini_timeout_seconds
variables.label: Google Gemini Timeout (seconds)
variables.description: Bounded request timeout, from 1 through 120 seconds.

variables.name: openai_api_key
variables.label: OpenAI API Key
variables.description: Write-only OpenAI API key used only by the OpenAI provider.

variables.name: openai_model
variables.label: OpenAI TTS Model
variables.description: Approved OpenAI TTS model.

variables.name: openai_voice
variables.label: OpenAI Default Voice
variables.description: Voice used when the agent does not pick one (e.g. alloy, coral, nova, onyx).

variables.name: openai_timeout_seconds
variables.label: OpenAI Timeout (seconds)
variables.description: Bounded request timeout, from 1 through 120 seconds.

variables.name: openrouter_enabled
variables.label: Enabled
variables.description: Enable OpenRouter speech synthesis using the configured credential.

variables.name: openrouter_api_key
variables.label: OpenRouter API Key
variables.description: Write-only OpenRouter API key used only by the OpenRouter provider.

variables.name: openrouter_model
variables.label: OpenRouter TTS Model
variables.description: Model used when the agent does not pick one, e.g. hexgrad/kokoro-82m or mistralai/voxtral-mini-tts-2603. Use the exact ID from the OpenRouter model page.

variables.name: openrouter_voice
variables.label: OpenRouter Default Voice
variables.description: Persona used when the agent does not pick one. Agents may pick any persona in this list, this default, or an "Other Allowed Voice". Voices are model-specific, so match it to the model.

options.label: af_heart — Kokoro, Heart, US female, A-
af_bella — Kokoro, Bella, US female, A-
af_nicole — Kokoro, Nicole, US female, B-
bf_emma — Kokoro, Emma, UK female, B-

variables.name: openrouter_allowed_models
variables.label: Other Allowed OpenRouter Models
variables.description: Comma-separated model IDs an agent may request besides the default.

variables.name: openrouter_allowed_voices
variables.label: Other Allowed Voices
variables.description: Comma-separated extra voice IDs agents may use, beyond the personas in the dropdown (e.g. jf_alpha, ef_dora). Agents cannot use any other voice.

variables.name: openrouter_timeout_seconds
variables.label: OpenRouter Timeout (seconds)
variables.description: Bounded request timeout, from 1 through 300 seconds. Some TTS models take over two minutes.

variables.name: elevenlabs_enabled
variables.label: Enabled
variables.description: Enable ElevenLabs speech synthesis using the configured credential.

variables.name: elevenlabs_api_key
variables.label: ElevenLabs API Key
variables.description: Write-only ElevenLabs API key used only by the ElevenLabs provider.

variables.name: elevenlabs_model
variables.label: ElevenLabs TTS Model
variables.description: Approved ElevenLabs model. Eleven v3/v4 follow inline audio tags in the text such as [whispers] or [sighs].

options.label: eleven_v4 — Eleven v4, most expressive, 90+ languages
eleven_v4_turbo — Eleven v4 Turbo, lower latency
eleven_v3 — Eleven v3, expressive with audio tags

variables.name: elevenlabs_voice
variables.label: ElevenLabs Default Voice
variables.description: Voice ID used when the agent does not pick one. Agents may pick any voice in this list, this default, or an "Other Allowed Voice". Library voices require a paid ElevenLabs plan.

options.label: Arunika — Indonesian, female, TV voice over (library voice, paid plan)
Putra — Indonesian, male, smooth (library voice, paid plan)
Pratama — Indonesian, male, confident (library voice, paid plan)
Putri Maharani — Indonesian (Javanese), female (library voice, paid plan)

variables.name: elevenlabs_language_code
variables.label: ElevenLabs Language Code
variables.description: Optional ISO 639-1 language code (e.g. id for Indonesian) to enforce. Leave empty to auto-detect.

variables.name: elevenlabs_allowed_voices
variables.label: Other Allowed Voices
variables.description: Comma-separated extra ElevenLabs voice IDs agents may use, beyond the voices in the dropdown. Agents cannot use any other voice.

variables.name: elevenlabs_timeout_seconds
variables.label: ElevenLabs Timeout (seconds)
variables.description: Bounded request timeout, from 1 through 300 seconds.

variables.name: allow_agent_overrides
variables.label: Allow Agents To Choose Provider, Model and Voice
variables.description: Off: agents always get the provider, model and voice configured here (their own choices are ignored). On: agents may pick another enabled provider, an approved model, or an approved voice persona per request.

variables.name: max_text_length
variables.label: Maximum Characters Per Request
variables.description: Upper limit for text length in a single request (up to 4000).

variables.name: requests_per_minute
variables.label: Requests Per Minute Per Agent
variables.description: Per-agent rolling request cap, from 1 through 60.

variables.name: max_concurrent_requests
variables.label: Maximum Concurrent Requests Per Agent
variables.description: Per-agent in-flight synthesis cap (1 through 4).

variables.name: characters_per_day
variables.label: Characters Per Day Per Agent
variables.description: Per-agent rolling 24-hour character quota.

provider_selector.label: Provider
provider_selector.description: Choose the provider you want to configure. Your unsaved values are retained while you switch providers.

providers.label: Google Gemini
providers.description: Cloud speech synthesis through an approved Gemini TTS model.

providers.label: OpenAI
providers.description: Cloud speech synthesis through an approved OpenAI TTS model.

providers.label: OpenRouter
providers.description: Cloud speech synthesis through OpenRouter (OpenAI, Mistral Voxtral, Gemini and more) with an administrator-approved model.

providers.label: ElevenLabs
providers.description: Cloud speech synthesis through ElevenLabs (Eleven v4/v3 with audio tags, Indonesian and 70+ languages).

providers.label: Deterministic Mock
providers.description: Development-only provider that returns a short silent WAV.

global_section.label: Global Text to Speech Defaults
global_section.description: These preferences apply to Text to Speech regardless of the provider you are configuring.
